architectureInterpretation.materials: OSM tags when present; otherwise regional interpretation, not surveyed
architectureInterpretation.openings: procedural and closed; not observed facades
architectureInterpretation.heritage: existing OSM outlines and illustrative heights retained

provenance.projection: same legacy local X-east/Z-south frame as source terrain; metres

osm.warning: Incomplete OSM tags; no authoritative elevation or building heights.

provenance.confidence: Procedural decoration derived from mapped geography; not measured individuals or surveyed architecture

interpretation: Exact deterministic procedural instances and decoration buffers from the versioned geographic sources. No new measured geography or changed vegetation density. Provider-independent chunks.

runtimeTransforms.method: Legacy pack positions, materials and payload checksums preserved. At hydration: outward face winding/normals, then deterministic window identity attributes. Wall feet exposed by the local road reconstruction extend to corrected ground; no footprint or opening relocation.

forestLayer.purpose: Original tree anchors retained; renderer replaces the old tree library and source-bound supplementary stems are loaded separately. Architecture/detail pack bytes unchanged.
